mapping.deviation_notes: A Hollow Form MA player gets a faithful spin-AoE with a charge-fueled proxy loop, but the CLONE MULTIPLICITY (multiple images each spinning simultaneously = output-multiplication by clone count) is softened: the engine models one whirlwind geometry + a linked-cast trigger, so the 'my clones spin for me and I just tap the button' identity lands as a single spin with a charge-accumulator feed rather than N parallel spinning bodies. mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-11 GX-17 (corpus flags). Hollow Form = CLONE-CAST proxy delivery: clones replicate the Whirling Assault spin (Way of the Stonefist ascendancy). The Power Charge economy is the engine of the loop: Hollow Form consumes a Power Charge to spawn a clone, Lochtonial Caress gives clones a chance to refund charges -> charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator with a self-feeding refund. Modeled the clone auto-cast as proc_trigger_condition=on-cast-linked / consequence_type=linked-cast (the clone fires the spin when summoned). MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 holds (Hollow Form -> clone-spin is one link). physical -> element-neutral (physical rule). Ascendancy notables (Hollow Form Technique, Way of the Stonefist) route via main-law §5 -> the charge/momentum door group. NOT a spirit-reservation kit (no Spirit cost attested; reservation_resource null).
mapping_json.motion_frame: tap-to-summon spin proxies: press Hollow Form and short-lived clones each spin Whirling Assault for you, Power Charges fuel each clone spawn and Lochtonial Caress feeds charges back to keep the loop self-sustaining
